CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role')
  )::text
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
  )::uuid
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER atomic_history_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.calculation_history FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.guard_atomic_history()

CREATE TRIGGER atomic_scenario_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.saved_scenarios FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.guard_atomic_workspace()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.atomic_snapshot_valid(slug text, version integer, inputs jsonb, outputs jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(char_length(slug) BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND btrim(slug)<>''
 AND version>0 AND jsonb_typeof(inputs)='object' AND jsonb_typeof(outputs)='object'
 AND NOT jsonb_path_exists(inputs, '$.** ? (@.type() == "number" && (@ > 1.7976931348623157e308 || @ < -1.7976931348623157e308))')
 AND NOT jsonb_path_exists(outputs, '$.** ? (@.type() == "number" && (@ > 1.7976931348623157e308 || @ < -1.7976931348623157e308))'),false)
$function$
